outcome_semantics.STAY: The current placement P0 already satisfies the updated requirement. No new placement is required.
outcome_semantics.OFFLOAD: P0 does not satisfy the updated requirement, but at least one feasible placement P1 exists.
outcome_semantics.INFEASIBLE: P0 does not satisfy the updated requirement and no feasible P1 exists under the benchmark constraints.

placement_evaluation_semantics.primary_criterion: A predicted P1 must be independently validated for feasibility against the grounded requirement, application constraints, infrastructure capacities, network constraints, and eligible tiers.
placement_evaluation_semantics.resource_offload: reference_candidate_placements are known feasible target-service-only reconfigurations. They are reference solutions, not the only placements that may be accepted.
placement_evaluation_semantics.e2e_offload: reference_placement is the placement returned by the differential solver, which minimizes moved services first. It is an optimization reference and not necessarily the unique acceptable placement.
placement_evaluation_semantics.quality_metric: Compare the number of moved services of a feasible predicted placement against minimum_moves.

resource_model.aggregation: Resource requirements of all services placed on a node are summed.
resource_model.feasibility_condition: For each node and each resource, the sum of service requirements must not exceed node capacity.
resource_model.updated_resource_requirement: For RESOURCE scenarios, the target service baseline requirement for the target KPI is replaced by the new structured requirement value.

network_delay_model.multi_hop_communication_delay: Shortest-path sum of per-link transmission delays.

e2e_delay_model.processing_delay: Sum of wcet[0] for all services belonging to the flow path.
e2e_delay_model.communication_delay: Sum of shortest-path communication delays for all application flow hops.
e2e_delay_model.target_flow_constraint: For an E2E scenario, the target flow uses the new structured requirement value.
e2e_delay_model.non_target_flow_constraint: Other flows retain their current_e2e_max constraint.

outcome_derivation.STAY: P0 is feasible under the updated requirements.
outcome_derivation.OFFLOAD: P0 is infeasible but at least one feasible P1 exists.
outcome_derivation.INFEASIBLE: P0 is infeasible and no feasible placement exists in the placement search space.

optimization_objective.move_count: Number of services whose P1 node differs from their P0 node.

notes: The exact same 600 samples selected for E2E V1 are preserved.
STAY/OFFLOAD/INFEASIBLE are workflow outcomes, not direct solver classification outputs.
The solver is responsible for computing a feasible P1 when reconfiguration is required.
Exact placement matching must not be used as the primary placement metric because multiple feasible P1 placements may exist.
